short: acronym pieces from S, C, D, L, M
notes: Card: ' SM' x6, 'CL' x5, 'SM' x3, 'CD' x2, '.M' x2, 'MC' x2. Probes: 'CL' 0.848, 'C' in SMC 0.694, 'SM' 0.672, 'CD' 0.586; ordinary words 0.03-0.04. Near misses use acronyms from other letters that are whole tokens, or plain words.
